items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Yeah, I started my son, Debe Ridgely. ... he came that one night. Cause he played a couple of pieces for me.

ctx.x: He was sick for a while, but he's, uh, He's doing pretty good now. He gets around again.
Yeah, I started my son, Debe Ridgely. We was playing at, uh, um... Marry-go-round. Up in there. Yeah, well he came that one night. Mm-hmm. Cause he played a couple of pieces for me.
I don't think he's played for a long time either. No. No, I guess he's stuck like me.
